# FundAdmin AI — plugin for Claude Code, Claude Cowork and Codex

62 fund administration skills for Claude Code, Cowork and Codex: review LPAs, PPMs, side letters, capital calls, distributions, K-1s and capital account statements; draft notices and investor letters; run compliance, KYC/AML and FATCA/CRS checks; track obligations and MFN elections; model performance and cash flows; and produce PDF reports.

Version 1.0.0 · MIT · 62 skills · 5 agents · works without any server, database or API key.

> **Not financial, legal, or tax advice.** Every skill produces document analysis and drafts to support fund administration work. Have qualified professionals review anything you rely on.

## Install

**Claude Code**

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills
claude plugin install fundadmin@fundadmin-ai-skills
```

Or, inside a session: `/plugin marketplace add davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills` then `/plugin install fundadmin@fundadmin-ai-skills`.

**Claude Cowork**

Customize → Plugins → **Add marketplace** → enter `davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills` → install **FundAdmin AI**.

**Codex**

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills
codex plugin add fundadmin@fundadmin-ai-skills
```

**Without a plugin system** (plain `~/.claude/skills/` install): `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai/main/install.sh | bash` from the [source repository](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai).

**Optional:** `pip3 install reportlab` enables the branded PDF report (`report-pdf`). Everything else needs no dependencies.

## Use

Type `/fundadmin:fund` for the menu, then any command with the same prefix:

```
/fundadmin:fund review-lpa ./Apex-Capital-Fund-III-LPA.pdf
/fundadmin:fund review-capital-call ./call-notice-2026-Q3.pdf
/fundadmin:fund draft-capital-call ./commitments.csv
```

Each sub-skill is also callable directly (`/fundadmin:fund-review-lpa <file>`), and Claude will pick the right one on its own when you drop a fund document into the conversation and describe what you need. In Codex, mention `$fund-review-lpa` (or any skill name) or just describe the task.

Outputs are markdown files under `reviews/<fund-slug>/<date>/` in your working directory, in fixed filename families (`LPA-REVIEW-…`, `CAPITAL-CALL-REVIEW-…`, `PERFORMANCE-REPORT-…`), so downstream skills such as `report-pdf`, `counsel-handoff` and `search-precedent` can find them.

## The 5 agents

`review-lpa` launches these as parallel subagents and combines them into the **LPA Safety Score** (0–100). On a host without subagents the skill runs the same five prompts inline.

| Agent | Role |
|---|---|
| `fundadmin:fund-compliance` | Regulatory compliance analyst for the /fund review-lpa pipeline (20% of the LPA Safety Score). |
| `fundadmin:fund-obligations` | Obligations and timeline analyst for the /fund review-lpa pipeline (15% of the LPA Safety Score). |
| `fundadmin:fund-recommendations` | Recommendations analyst for the /fund review-lpa pipeline (20% of the LPA Safety Score). |
| `fundadmin:fund-risks` | Risk assessment analyst for the /fund review-lpa pipeline (25% of the LPA Safety Score). |
| `fundadmin:fund-terms` | Terms and provisions analyst for the /fund review-lpa pipeline (20% of the LPA Safety Score). |

## What is in the package

```
plugins/fundadmin/
├── .claude-plugin/plugin.json   Claude Code / Cowork manifest
├── .codex-plugin/plugin.json    Codex manifest
├── skills/fund/                 orchestrator + scripts/generate_fund_pdf.py + templates/
├── skills/fund-*/SKILL.md       the 62 skills
├── agents/fund-*.md             the 5 LPA-review agents
└── evals/                       `claude plugin eval` cases
```

No hooks, no MCP servers, no network calls. The skills read the files you point them at and write markdown next to them. The optional Obsidian vault integration (`vault-init`, `vault-sync`, and the `vault_*` MCP tools other skills use when present) is documented in the [source repository](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai); every skill works without it.

## Privacy

The plugin runs entirely inside your Claude or Codex session. It sends nothing anywhere itself; documents go only where your AI host already sends them. `monitor-email` is the one skill that reads an external service, and only through a Gmail connector you have enabled.
